# KDD — Knowledge-Driven Development

> Template repository for the KDD methodology: OKF (Open Knowledge Format)
> for structuring knowledge as markdown + CCDD (Contract-Driven Development)
> for deterministic gates. This page publishes the methodology's own knowledge
> as searchable, hash-pinned skills.

## Docs

- [Landing (visual walkthrough)](/KDD/index.html)
- [Repository](https://github.com/MauricioPerera/KDD)

## Skills

Skills published by the KDD template - search and browse the methodology's own OKF knowledge bundle (spec, contracts, architecture, validation).

- [search_knowledge](/KDD/skills/search_knowledge/SKILL.md): BM25 search over this origin's published knowledge bundle. Use it to find which concept answers a question before fetching it. <!-- skill: {"version":"0.1.0","license":"MIT","sha256":"652e3bc0f8edc27f225177d3874e9cf09dae5cdf60ee98526c99c000902f9cde","tool":"/KDD/skills/search_knowledge/tool.js","tool_sha256":"b13a3c0448c4ee8c744b1ee33b1dd441ecc0c7c3552e23f04b5f9aaf79049ab7"} -->
